entry.name: rnbo_delay
entry.digest: Delay a bang by a given time (ms)
entry.description: Delay a bang for a specified length in milliseconds. Unlike the Max version in which a new bang resets the delay, multiple bangs can be delayed and output.

arguments.name: time
arguments.description: The amount of time in milliseconds to delay the output of incoming bangs.
